name: netflow
description: Receives the flow records OPNsense's NetFlow export sends (version 9, over UDP), and reads which interfaces the export captures on: when it captures exactly one, that interface is every record's Observation Point and the records are joined to the logged connections as their measured volume.

endpoints.name: getconfig
endpoints.survey_section: Push sources: remote syslog and NetFlow export, read from source for push sources
endpoints.note: Read-only: getconfigAction answers the OPNsense.Netflow model's getNodes() on a GET. {netflow: {capture: {interfaces, egress_only, version, targets}, collect: {enable}, activeTimeout, inactiveTimeout}}, each option list an object of {value, selected} keyed by the option.

endpoints.name: is_enabled
endpoints.survey_section: Push sources: remote syslog and NetFlow export, read from source for push sources
endpoints.note: {netflow: 0|1, local: 0|1}; netflow is 1 exactly when capture.targets and capture.interfaces are both non-empty.
